minutes.headline: Stormwater Task Force kept its March meeting to possibly seek town meeting funding for a required demonstration BMP.
minutes.summary: The task force discussed roadside groundwater and ice problems, approved January minutes, and reviewed the DPW's cost data collection, including a spreadsheet that was missing two lines. Updates covered the asset management grant kickoff and the MS4-required demonstration BMP, with a rain garden at the high school or Marshall Park favored. The group agreed to hold a March 16th meeting and adjourned.

votes.motion: Approve minutes of the January 19th meeting

budget_items.topic: DPW equipment hourly cost and drainage work data
budget_items.what_was_said: DPW director added equipment hourly cost columns and January drainage work to the tracking spreadsheet; the contractor sheet had one update, a CEI bill.
A member found the line items did not sum to year-to-date expended; two lines were missing from the printout, one for Lakeview Landscaping plunge pool cleaning and one for CEI.
CEI kicked off mapping pipes into GIS, to be finished by the end of the calendar year.
Construction cost is modest but design cost is expected to be the significant part; stormwater funds or a town meeting article were floated.

decisions.decision: Keep the March 16th meeting in place in case action is needed, with the chair to confirm by the eighth.
CEI to provide preliminary cost estimates for the demonstration BMP so the town representative can raise it with the select board.
A member will review the Central Mass stormwater Coalition website and report back on training resources.

what_happened.line: The task force agreed to keep its March 16th meeting in place in case action is needed, with the chair to confirm the date by the eighth.
CEI is to provide preliminary cost estimates for a demonstration BMP so the town representative can raise it with the select board.
The demonstration BMP, required under the MS4 permit, is expected to be modest to build, with design the significant cost; stormwater funds or a town meeting article were floated.
A member found the stormwater project spreadsheet's line items did not sum to year-to-date expended; two lines, one for plunge pool cleaning and one for CEI, were missing from the printout.
CEI began mapping pipes into GIS under the asset management grant, to be finished by the end of the calendar year.

why_it_matters: A required stormwater demonstration project may need money, either from stormwater funds or from a town meeting article that residents would be asked to vote on.
The spreadsheet that tracks stormwater spending was missing two lines when printed, so its totals did not tie to year-to-date spending until those lines were found.
